intent: Tags the person types. Enter or a delimiter adds one. Optional suggestions and an optional maximum with a visible count.
useWhen: Free-form labels such as keywords the person creates
A short list of suggestions while they type, without a fixed option set
doNotUseWhen: Choosing from a fixed list — use MultiSelect
One value from a list — use Combobox or Select

size.note: Same 32 / 36 / 40 frame as Input and Button. lg uses md tags.

suggestions.note: Shown while typing. Picking one adds a tag.

delimiters.note: Single-character keys that commit a tag, besides Enter.

maxTags.note: Most tags allowed. Shows a count such as 3/8 at the end of the field. Adds past it are blocked with a message.

requirements: Escape closes only this panel, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Input is role=combobox when suggestions are open
Enter or a delimiter adds the typed text. Arrow keys move through suggestions
Backspace on an empty query highlights the last tag and says 'Press Backspace to remove {tag}'; a second Backspace removes it. Any other key clears the highlight
A duplicate tag, compared case-insensitively, is not added; '{tag} is already added' is shown with an icon and announced (aria-live polite)
With maxTags, the count is in the input's aria-describedby ('3 of 8 tags'); an add past the limit is announced, not silently dropped
Escape closes suggestions. Each tag remove button removes that tag
Must have a Field label or ariaLabel
built-in labels (suggestions, tagExists, tagLimit, tagCount, removeTagHint) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not use TagInput to choose from a required option list — use MultiSelect
Do not invent a local chip — tags are kit Tag
snippet: <Field label="Invoice labels" htmlFor="labels"><TagInput id="labels" placeholder="Add a label" maxTags={8} suggestions={labels} /></Field>
